first.rationale: The current activation and onboarding declines directly threaten durable revenue, so simplifying onboarding is the leading action. Verify memory_86 to determine whether its completion and adoption gains translated into qualified revenue or only early-funnel metrics. Verify memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest competing response to the competitor, but its evidence may not establish retention, margin, or long-term customer quality. A guarded test is appropriate until those downstream effects are clear.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source for memory_86 directly addresses the current onboarding decline and shows improved completion, faster time-to-value, and a positive 30-day retention effect. Memory_31 provides additional evidence that signup simplification can improve SMB activation. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because its verified cohort suffered a 12% retention decline, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. The experiment should track qualified revenue and retention beyond early activation because long-term revenue impact remains uncertain.
